# SD13-E2 deterministic Gnome Fighter level 1 race-semantics recognition fixture.
# Represents a deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Gnome Fighter level 1 identity as
# chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or
# parity values. The ability scores already reflect the fixed PF1 Core Gnome +2
# Constitution / -2 Strength racial adjustment (recognition-only on the compute
# seam, not arithmetic performed there).
#
# The Fighter combat baseline, total saves, and selected-skill modifiers stay
# claim-blocked on this input because the bounded GE-06 Fighter compute path is
# grounded only for race:human; that is expected and unrelated to this fixture's
# purpose, which is to make the bounded Gnome race-semantics recognition legible.
# It deliberately avoids every unproven Gnome family: no racial bonus feat (PF1
# core Gnomes gain none), no Defensive Training, no Illusion Resistance, no
# Hatred, no Keen Senses Perception bonus, no Gnome Magic spell-like abilities,
# and no weapon familiarity grant.
case_id=pf1-crb-gnome-fighter-level1-recognition
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:gnome
class_level=class:fighter:1
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:14
ability=intelligence:12
ability=wisdom:10
ability=charisma:10
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-13-core-class-race-roster-and-level-10-progression-matrix/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
